Consequences:
- While _sos_active is True, PUT can replace emergency with busy/available/offline. GET and Observe then advertise a non-emergency status until the next tick. Spec 18.5.3 says SOS active -> emergency.
- PUT with battery < 10 can omit low_battery. Spec 18.5.3 says add the flag when battery < 10%.
- note_sos(False) restores _pre_sos from SOS start, discarding any PUT that happened during SOS.

- python/src/lichen/coap/resources/presence.py render_put (approx lines 149-174)
- python/src/lichen/presence.py apply_automatic_status
